business_summary: Yashima & Co.,Ltd. engages in the sale, maintenance, and import/export of railway related products and electronic parts for industrial machines in Japan and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Railway Business and General Business. It offers tachometer generators, connectors, optical harness, sensors, door switches, terminal boards, power supply devices, polycarbonate window units, compressors for air conditioning, brake parts, wheelsets, wipers, flooring materials, and other electrical and mechanical parts and maintenance equipment. The company sells its products to railway operators, railway vehicle manufacturers, manufacturers of electrical components for railway vehicles and body equipment, industrial equipment manufacturers, electric power equipment manufacturers, automotive manufacturers, and commercial equipment mail order business operators. Yashima & Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: LEOCLAN Co.,Ltd. operates as a medical equipment trading company that meets various medical care, welfare, and health needs. It operates through three segments: Medical Total Solutions Business, Remote Image Diagnosis Service Business, and School Lunch Business. The Medical Total Solutions Business segment provides incidental maintenance services; and interior decoration construction and installation works for medical institutions, preventive/health checkup facilities, nursing care and welfare facilities, etc. based on consulting services, such as selection of medical equipment, as well as sells medical equipment and medical information systems. The Remote Image Diagnosis Service Business segment offers services in which diagnostic radiology specialists remotely diagnose image data taken by MRI, CT, etc., and provides information. The School Lunch Business segment provides school lunch services, including regular meals, medical meals, and other meals to nursing care and welfare facilities. LEOCLAN Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Settsu, Japan.

business_summary: BuySell Technologies Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the reuse business for kimonos and branded items in Japan. The company purchases and sells art and antiques, Chinese yuan, kimonos, precious metals, bags, jewelry, watches, alcohol, cameras, and short-term baby and children's items through its EC sites, stores, sales events, and B2B auctions. It also engages in the reuse franchise business; and the recycling of branded goods and precious metals. BuySell Technologies Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

Cloud Computing is a technology that delivers computing services—such as servers, storage, and networking—over the internet on an on-demand, pay-as-you-go model. It allows users to acquire necessary resources without needing to purchase and maintain their own physical IT infrastructure. This model enables users to quickly scale resources up or down according to business needs, significantly improving cost efficiency and operational flexibility. Advantages of Cloud Computing Cost-Effectiveness CapEx to OpEx Shift: Shift spending from capital expenditure (buying expensive hardware, data centers) to operating expenditure. Pay-as-you-go: Only pay for the compute resources you actually use, minimizing wasted resources. Elasticity and Scalability Rapid Scaling: The ability to quickly increase (scale up/out) or decrease (scale down/in) computing power, storage, or bandwidth in minutes according to business demand. Handling Peaks: Easily manage sudden traffic spikes or seasonal demands without worrying about resource shortages. Focus on Core Business Reduced Management Overhead: Transfer the burden of tedious IT management tasks (hardware maintenance, OS updates, security patching) to the cloud provider. Accelerated Innovation: Allow development teams to concentrate on application development and business logic, speeding up the time to market. business_summary: Shimadzu Corporation provides equipment solutions in Japan, the United States of America, Europe, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Measuring Equipment, Medical Equipment, Industrial Equipment, and Aircraft Equipment Business. The company offers analytical and measuring instruments which includes gas and liquid chromatography, gas and liquid chromatograph-mass spectrometry, software and informatics, molecular spectroscopy, elemental analysis, surface analysis, life science lab instrument, material testing, non-destructive testing, total organic carbon analysis, continuous monitoring analysis, thermal analysis, particle size analysis, and balance products, as well as MALDI-based instruments and solutions, columns, reagents, and consumables products. It also provides medical systems comprising angiography, fluoroscopy, mobile C-arm, radiography, mobile X-ray systems, PET, and fluorescence imaging products; optical devices which consist of diffraction gratings, aspherical mirrors, laser mirrors and windows for high power lasers, polka-dot beam splitters, laser spectrum analyzers, and precision refractometers. In addition, the company offers vacuum and industrial machinery, including turbo molecular pumps, helium leak detectors, multi deposition system, vacuum heat-treatment furnaces, liquid delivery equipment gear pumps, mechatronic systems glass fiber winders, ferromagnetic object detectors, underwater optical wireless communication, liquid crystal injection system, and dynamic balancing machines. Further, it provides hydraulic equipment, such as hydraulic gear pumps, power packages, and multi control valves; and aircraft equipment, including electro-mechanical actuators, flight control systems, and landing gear systems. It serves spectroscopic analysis, optical communication, laser, medical, and food industries. The company was founded in 1875 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

business_summary: JMS Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture, sale, export, and import of medical devices and pharmaceuticals in Japan, Asia, North America, Europe, China, South Korea, Thailand, and internationally. It offers infusion and nutrition solutions, which includes needless access port, closed drug mixing and infusion system, infusion pump, and oral and enteral nutrition system for treatment and laboratory testing; and dialysis solutions including dialysis equipment for hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis solution, and APD equipment that automatically performs the injection and discharge of peritoneal dialysis solution, as well as offers hemodialysis machines. It also provides surgical treatment solution comprising products that are used in cardiac surgery and cardiovascular internal medicine, such as membrane oxygenator and cardiopulmonary blood pump systems. In addition, the company offers blood management and cell therapy solutions, which includes serum collection sets and blood bags. Further, it provides logistics and other equipment; and offers maintenance works and sanatorium services. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

Precision System Science Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, manufacturing, and sale of automated systems/instruments, other physicochemical instruments, software, and other products in Japan. It also offers geneLEAD series; extraction reagents for nucleic acid extraction and biochemical testing; and LecChip series products. In addition, the company manufactures and sells reagents, as well as plastic consumables for use in the automated system/instruments. Its products are used in research and development, and practical application of in vitro diagnosis testing market, including genetic and protein tests. Precision System Science Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Matsudo, Japan.

business_summary: KUBOTEK Corporation manufactures and sells computer systems, robots, exterior inspection systems, and line observation/monitoring/management systems in Japan, the United States, South Korea, Taiwan, China, and internationally. It manufactures and sells flexible and versatile inspection products for manufacturing industry. The company also supplies systems that integrate the compression of image, video data and network for use in various remote monitoring systems, public video display systems. In addition, it provides computer assisted creation systems that integrate the measurement and machining functions with the modeling function. KUBOTEK Corporation was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Sukegawa Electric Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells energy and industrial systems in Japan. It offers mineral insulated cables, including simple and multi-core coaxial, two and four-core double-sheathed, two and four-core twisted, and banded-type cables; temperature sensors comprising thermocouples, resistance bulbs, sheathed wires, and heat flux sensors; micro heaters for general type industrial plants and various apparatuses for experiments and also facilities related with vacuum components; and sheathed heaters that are used as the heat source for various devices. The company also provides a range of vacuum components, such as steping motors, aluminum alloy ultra vacuum chambers, vacuum systems, vacuum furnaces with carbon heater, hot plate with cold systems, and vacuum heat treating furnaces; and molten metal systems comprising electromagnetic pumps, Pb-Bi test loops, liquid level indicators, and electromagnetic flowmeters and pump type sand mold casting systems, as well as induction type level meters and control panels. In addition, it offers various apparatuses for making experiments, control system, fuel rods simulators, boiling water capsules, electromagnetic sensors, fuel cell gas heating units, fuel cell test facilities, and electromagnetic horns for use in the energy field. Further, its products are used in manufacturing equipment for semiconductors, FPDs, automobiles, steel; and safety confirmation testing equipment for research institutions, and nuclear power. Sukegawa Electric Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Takahagi, Japan.

business_summary: Nagano Keiki Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells pressure gauges and sensors, measurement and control equipment, die castings, and other products in Japan and internationally. It offers various pressure gauges, including compound, vacuum, differential, and low and absolute pressure gauges, as well as diaphragm-seal type products; mechanical and electric type pressure switches and indicators with switches; pressure and differential pressure transmitters, load and level sensors, and others; digital and digital differential pressure gauges, and digital indicators and meter relays; and temperature gauges. The company also provides flow and heat meters for water, air, and gas flowmeters, as well as heat meters and monitors; dead weight testers, liquid column manometers, precision aneroid manometers, and digital precision manometers; and accessories and regulators, ceramic products, measurement and control products, and noise level meters and vibration meters. It serves automobile, industrial vehicle and construction, FA and industrial machinery, HVAC and refrigerator, semiconductor, process instrumentation, and medical and welfare industries; food, drug, and cosmetics industries; marine, aeronautical, and rail industries; and high-pressure hydrogen, gas, and new energy industries. Nagano Keiki Co., Ltd. was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: V Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, sale, and service of equipment for flat panel displays (FPDs) and semiconductors in Japan. The company offers manufacturing and inspection equipment for the inspection, repair, and measurement of FPDs. It also provides photomask equipment; and parts and materials for manufacturing FPDs, as well as product maintenance and inspection service and maintenance parts, and offers equipment upgrade services. In addition, the company is involved in the semiconductor equipment business. The company was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

business_summary: Tokyo Koki Co. Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of various testing machines and measuring instruments in Japan. It operates through Testing Equipment Business, Engineering Business, and Other Business segments. The company offers testing equipment for automotive parts, shipment inspection of blast furnace and electric furnace steel, secondary products, research and development, civil engineering structures, and railway vehicle and equipment components, as well as universal, impact, hardness, and fatigue testing machines to industrial high schools, technical colleges, and universities. It also provides smart hyper load nut and t-spring; and CAE software. In addition, the company is involved in the development and sales of CAE software; provision of analytical consulting and development services; creation and provision of AI solutions; and virtual development of drones. Tokyo Koki Co. Ltd. was founded in 1923 and is headquartered in Sagamihara, Japan.

事業内容 事業内容 東京衡機グループの製品マップ × 工場 ASU/P-form / プレス成形シミュレーションソフトウエア 自動車部品の多くは、プレス成形によって製造されています。従来は、金型製作や試作を含む設計段階で試行錯誤を重ねる必要があり、製品完成までに多くの時間と費用を要していました。 ASU/P-formによるプレス成形シミュレーションは、こうした課題の改善に役立ちます。設計・試作プロセスの一部をシミュレーションに置き換えることで、金型製作や試作にかかるコストの削減と、開発期間の短縮に貢献しています。 水素自動車・水素ステーション ASU/FrontCOMP 3D FCV（燃料電池自動車）は、水素と空気中の酸素の化学反応によって電気を生み出し、その電気でモーターを動かして走行する自動車です。 FCVや水素ステーションで使用される水素容器には、大気圧の700倍もの高圧水素に耐えうる性能が求められており、炭素繊維を用いた炭素繊維強化プラスチック（CFRP）製の高圧容器が主流となっています。 その設計には、先端力学シミュレーション研究所の複合材料強度信頼性評価シミュレーター ASU/FrontCOMP が活用されており、材料コストを抑えながら高圧容器の強度確保に寄与しています。 自動車 ASU/V-Struct 自動車の天井材であるヘッドライニングは、見た目の美しさはもちろん、断熱や収納などの機能も兼ね備えた重要な部品です。 多層の積層体をプレス加工して成形するため、製造には高度な技術が求められ、従来は多くの時間とコストがかかっていました。 先端力学シミュレーション研究所の ASU/V-Struct を活用したシミュレーション技術により、しわや破れなどの不良低減に加え、開発期間やコストの削減にもつながっています。 鉄道 性能・耐久試験装置 鉄道のレールや車体部品には、長年の使用に耐えうる強度と信頼性が求められます。 東京衡機試験機は、実際の走行環境を再現できる性能・耐久試験装置を通じて、素材や部品の信頼性を科学的に検証し、社会インフラの安全を支えています。 製鉄所 各種材料試験機 建築物や車両、エネルギー設備に欠かせない鉄には、高い品質と信頼性が求められます。 東京衡機試験機は、引張試験、衝撃試験、クリープ試験など多様な試験機を通じて鉄の性質を評価し、ものづくり産業の基盤となる品質保証を支えています。 土木 コンクリート・鉄筋強度試験装置 橋やトンネル、建物などの構造物では、安全性の確認が欠かせません。 東京衡機試験機は、コンクリートや鉄筋の強度を測る装置を通じて、人々が安心して暮らせる社会基盤の維持に貢献しています。 トラック 性能・耐久・衝撃試験装置 トラックをはじめとする自動車の「走る・止まる・曲がる」を支える部品には、厳しい環境下でも安定した性能が求められます。 東京衡機試験機は、性能試験、耐久試験、衝撃試験装置を通じて、安全で持続可能なモビリティ社会の実現を支えています。 学校 各種試験・実験装置 大学や研究機関では、材料の基礎から応用まで、幅広い実験・教育の現場で東京衡機試験機の装置が活用されています。 「測る」「確かめる」技術を通じて、未来のエンジニアを育て、次代のものづくりを支えています。 高速道路 ゆるみ止め製品 高速道路では、車両の走行により継続的に振動が発生しています。 こうした繰り返しの振動に対しては、ナットのゆるみを防ぐための対策が重要となります。 当社のゆるみ止め製品は多くの箇所に採用されており、「採用して以来、ゆるみがなくなった」とのお声もいただいています。 使用箇所：恒久足場、遮音壁、ガードレール、看板等 ビル建築 ゆるみ止め製品 ビル建築では、当社の製品がさまざまな箇所で使用されています。 特に多く使用されているのが、外装材として外壁に取り付けられる部材です。 近年は、ビルの高層化や台風の大型化に伴い、より高いゆるみ防止性能が求められており、当社製品の採用が拡大しています。 使用箇所：サッシ、ルーバー、看板、手すり等 住宅 ゆるみ止め製品 住宅分野は、近年当社製品の採用が広がっている分野の一つです。 木造建築では、経年による木材のやせにより、十分に締め付けを行っていても避けられないゆるみが発生する可能性があります。 一度ゆるみが発生すると、点検時まで気づきにくいという課題があります。 当社のゆるみ止め製品は、こうした木やせによるゆるみの抑制にも役立っています。 使用箇所：梁、ホールダウン 東京衡機を支える3つの事業内容 当社グループは、「試験機事業」「エンジニアリング事業」「デジタル事業」の3つの領域で、ものづくりの現場を支える総合技術サービスを展開しています。製品の性能や安全性を評価する試験機・計測機器の開発をはじめ、産業機器向けの精密部品の製造、さらには仮想空間上でのシミュレーションや解析を可能にするソフトウェアの提供まで、リアルとデジタルの両面からお客様の課題解決と製品開発を支援しています。技術と信頼を軸に、持続可能な社会の実現に貢献してまいります。 東京衡機試験機は、原子力発電設備向けガスタービン材料の耐久性評価に欠かせない高精度クリープ試験機を提供しています。 高温・長時間にわたる厳しい運転条件下での材料特性を忠実に再現し、国際規格に準拠した信頼性の高いデータ取得を可能とします。 豊富な納入実績と独自の自動荷重制御技術により、研究開発から実機評価まで幅広く対応。 次世代エネルギーの安全性・効率性向上に貢献するパートナーとして、最適なソリューションをご提案いたします。 デジタルツインソリューション 東京衡機試験機は、試験機とCAE解析技術を融合させたデジタルツインソリューションを提供しています。 CAE解析で得られたデータをもとに実試験を行い その差異をコリレーションソフトウェアで補正することで、解析結果を実試験データに近づけることが可能です。 繰り返しの試験により CAE 解析の精度はさらに高まり、より実試験に近いシミュレーションを実現します。 主要 5 分野の事業紹介 自動車 「走る・曲がる・止まる」など自動車部品の材料強度・耐久性を評価する専用試験機を製造・販売。 材料段階・完成車レベルまで幅広く対応。 鉄鋼 高炉・電炉鋼、二次製品の出荷検査や研究開発用など、多用途の試験機ラインナップを有する。 建築・土木 business_summary: TOKYO KEIKI INC., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells marine and harbor, hydraulic and pneumatic, fluid, defense and communications, and inspection equipment in Japan and internationally. The company offers marine systems, including gyrocompass, fiber optic gyrocompass, autopilot systems, ECDIS, speed log, magnetic compass, straight leg course control unit, digital course recorder, and bridge navigation watch alarm system; fluid power systems, such as direct drive system, vane pumps, piston pumps, vane motors, COMNICA valve, digital valve, manifold block, power package, and switches and sensors. It also provides ultrasonic flowmeter, radar level gauge, other products, and partner company items; avionic systems and equipment, naval systems and equipment, and other products; maritime traffic products; vibrating silicon-gyro attitude sensor VSAS-T1G and VSAS-4GM, velocity type strong motion seismometer TSM-1, and for vibration isolation seismometer application servo accelerometer TA-25J; and fiber optic gyrocompass for tunnel. In addition, the company offers solid state power oscillator; web inspection system; and ultrasonic rail inspection car, ultrasonic rail flaw detector, portable ultrasonic rail flaw imager, switch profile gauge, expansion gap gauge, and datadepot system. The company was formerly known as Tokimec Inc. and changed its name to TOKYO KEIKI INC. in 2008. TOKYO KEIKI INC. was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Kokusai Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of testers and measurement instruments for motors and rotating equipment, and automatic inspection equipment in Japan, the United States, South Korea, China, and internationally. It offers balancing machines, tire balancers for production line, tire uniformity machines/tire and wheel assembly balancers, tire drum durability testing machines, road wheel balance and runout measuring equipment, tire balance weight appliers, shaft straightening machines, coil winding testers, motor testers for production line, gear testers, seismic systems, electric servo motor-driven vibration testers, and electrodynamic vibration testers. The company's products are used in automobiles, home appliances, and digital devices. Kokusai Co., Ltd. was founded in 1969 and is headquartered in Tama, Japan.

business_summary: Inter Action Corporation engages in the development, manufacturing, and sells inspection illuminators for applications in imaging semiconductor manufacturing processes in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Internet of Things Related Business; Environmental Energy Related Business; and Promotion Business of Industry 4.0. It offers image sensor inspection light source devices and pupil lens modules for manufacturing CCD and CMOS image sensors. The company also manufactures, sells, and maintains drying deodorizers for rotary printing presses in mass printing applications; and exhaust gas treatment systems for factories. In addition, it provides precision vibration isolation systems that protect precision equipment; and gear testing systems to gear manufacturers. Inter Action Corporation was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

イメージセンサの製造コスト削減、歩留まり向上や品質確保に貢献しています。 Illuminator CCD・C-MOSイメージセンサ向け 検査用光源装置 光源装置は決められた性質の光を作り出してイメージセンサに照射する装置であり、品質検査に必ず必要な装置です。 光源装置から照射された光に対してイメージセンサから正常な電気信号が出ているかを測定することで、不具合を検出することが可能です。光源装置は顧客の要望に応じて、個別にカスタマイズをして提供しています。 インターアクションの光源装置の強みは光学的な技術だけではなく、機械に関する技術や電気に関する技術を含めた複合的な根気強いアプローチにより、顧客の持つ問題に効果的な解決策を提示できることです。インターアクションの技術やカスタマーサービスは高く評価されており、光源装置における世界シェアはトップです。 Pupil Lens Module® (PLM®) モバイル用イメージセンサ向け 瞳モジュール® 瞳モジュール®はカメラのレンズ部分を再現した製品です。検査に使用することで、検査の段階においてイメージセンサが実際に使われる環境の再現をすることが可能であり、その環境下で決められたスペックを発揮できているか検査することができます。スマートフォンに搭載されているカメラの場合、多くはスマートフォンのモデル毎にレンズの枚数や形状が異なるため、瞳モジュール®はそれぞれのカメラレンズの仕様に合わせて都度設計されます。 瞳モジュール®は従来の品質検査に必須の製品ではありませんが、歩留まりの向上や品質保持に大きく貢献しています。 また、インターアクションのオリジナル製品であり、光源装置に次ぐ主力製品となっています。 CCD・C-MOSイメージセンサについて イメージセンサとは… レンズから取り込んだ光（画像）を電気信号に変換する半導体です。 人間の眼でいう網膜に相当する部分で、その性能がデジタルカメラ等で撮る写真の画質を大きく左右します。 イメージセンサには、画素（ピクセル）と呼ばれる、光を電気に変換するものが、基盤の目のように格子状で並んでいます。 2000万画素には2000万個の画素が並んでいます。 この画素に欠陥があると、表示画像に不具合が生じてしまいます。そのため、画素の良品・不良品を判断するための検査が重要となります。 business_summary: Kuroda Precision Industries Ltd. manufactures and sells motion control systems, press tools and die systems, and machine tools and measurement systems worldwide. It offers support tools, precision ground ball screws, and custom ball/JIS standard screws; ball screw actuators; line motion guides, support-units, greases, and feed screws; surface grinding machines; laminated precision press tools for motor core; and precision metal press products/motor core products. The company also provides parallel thread, taper thread/taper pipe thread, oil country, master/plain, and taper gauges; gauge blocks, test bars, and measuring instruments; wafer flatness measuring systems, wafer flatness/SORI measuring systems, and surface and flatness measuring systems, as well as surface and flatness measuring systems for large discs. In addition, it offers hydraulic tools; and minimal quantity lubrication systems, as well as clamping force tester and machine gauge. The company was formerly known as Kuroda Gauge Manufacturing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kuroda Precision Industries Ltd. in June 1965. business_summary: Tokyo Seimitsu Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells semiconductor manufacturing equipment and measuring instruments in Japan, China, Taiwan, South Korea, rest of East Asia, Southeast Asia, and internationally. The company offers wafer dicing and probing machines, polish and high rigid grinders, wafer manufacturing machines, chemical mechanical planarizers, edge shaping products, sliced wafer demounting and cleaning machines, precision dicing blades, and equipment for dicing and probing machines. It also provides 3D coordinate measuring machines, x-ray CT systems, non-contact and surface texture and contour measuring instruments, optical shaft measuring system, roundness and cylindrical profile measuring instruments, dedicated measuring machines, discharge test systems, and power supply evaluation services. In addition, the company offers laser interferometers, non-contact displacement sensors, grinder and lathe, machining center, sensors and electric/air micrometers, machine control gauges, various automated measuring, sorting and assembling machines, software products, and related accessories. business_summary: Nikon Corporation manufactures and sells optical instruments in Japan, North America, Europe, China, Thailand, and internationally. It operates through Imaging Business, Precision Equipment Business, Healthcare Business, Components Business, and Digital Manufacturing Business segments. The Imaging Business segment provides interchangeable-lens and integrated-lens digital cameras, digital cinema cameras, and others. The Precision Equipment Business segment offers FPD exposure equipment. The Healthcare Business segment provides products and services for the life science solutions field, such as biological microscopes and cell culture observation equipment. The Components Business segment offers industrial microscopes, measuring instruments, X-ray/CT inspection systems, optical components, optical parts and engineering equipment; and CODA, custom products, such as EUV-related components and space-related products. The Digital Manufacturing Business provides products and services of metal 3D printers. Nikon Corporation was incorporated in 1917 and is headquartered in Shinagawa, Japan.

business_summary: Olympus Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of medical equipment in Japan, America, the Middle East, Asia, and Oceania. It operates through two segments, Gastrointestinal Solutions and Surgical & Interventional Solutions. The company offers gastrointestinal Solutions products offer gastrointestinal endoscopes, gastroenterology devices, and medical services. The Surgical & Interventional Solutions provides urology, respiratory, surgical endoscopes, energy devices, ENT products, and gynecology products. business_summary: Riken Keiki Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, manufacturing, sales and after-sales maintenance of industrial gas detection and alarm equipment and analyzers in Japan and internationally. It offers gas detection and indicator alarm systems, portable and personal gas monitors, portable gas leak checkers, gas diffusion measurement services, toxic gas monitoring systems, oxygen monitoring systems, portable combination gas monitors, optical gas detection tubes, auto-emission analyzers, surface analyzers, medical gas indicators, and SALCON, a portable salinity analyzer. business_summary: SCREEN Holdings Co., Ltd. develops, manufactures, and markets semiconductor production equipment in Japan, Taiwan, South Korea, China, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Semiconductor Production Equipment, Graphic Arts Equipment, Display Production Equipment and Coater, and Printed Circuit Board (PCB)-Related Equipment segments. The company offers wafer cleaning systems, such as wet stations, spin processors, and spin scrubbers; coat/develop trackers, and spray coaters; flash lamp annealers; measurement systems, such as ellipsometric and spectroscopic film thickness measurement systems; inspection systems, including wafer pattern inspection systems; and packaging lithography equipment comprising direct imaging system for panel level packages and patterning, as well as display production equipment. It also provides coater systems, slit coaters, roll-to-roll, vacuum film deposition, wet process, dryer/heater, and exposure; inkjets, inkjet labelling printing systems, water-based inkjet systems for flexible packaging; thermal plate recorders; flexo letterpresses, hybrid AM/FM screening products, workflow solutions, Hirangino fonts, color proofing systems, and uservoice products, as well as network support services. In addition, the company offers artificial intelligence-enabled search systems, dictionary creation systems, and document quality improvement solutions; and image analysis and text mining visualization technologies. Further, it engages in the development and sale of imaging systems, and inkjet printing system for tablets, as well as medical devices for organ transplantation; and production of membrane electrode assemblies for fuel cells and rechargeable batteries. The company was formerly known as Dainippon Screen Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SCREEN Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2014. SCREEN Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1943 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

business_summary: Tamron Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells optical equipment in Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. It operates through three segments: Photography Products; Monitoring & FA Related Business; and Mobility and Healthcare Products, Others. The company offers interchangeable lenses for mirrorless and DSLR cameras. It also provides network surveillance camera lenses, FA and machine vision lenses, teleconferencing lenses, and camera modules. In addition, the company offers automotive camera and drone lenses, medical devices, various optical device units, and lenses for compact digital cameras and video cameras. The company was formerly known as Taisei Optical Equipment Manufacturing Inc. and changed its name to Tamron Co.,Ltd. in April 1970. business_summary: HOYA Corporation, a med-tech company, provides high-tech and medical products in the Japan, Asia, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. The company operates through two segments: Life Care, and Information and Communications. It offers life care products, including eyeglasses; contact lenses; medical endoscopes; intraocular lenses; laparoscopic surgical instruments; automatic endoscope cleaning equipment; and other medical related products, such as prosthetic ceramic fillers and metallic implants for orthopedics, brain surgery, and dentistry. The company also operates Eyecity, a specialty retailer of contact lenses. In addition, it provides information technology products, such as mask blanks and photomasks for manufacturing semiconductor chips; glass disks for hard disk drives; and imaging related products that comprise optical glasses/optical lenses, colored glass filters, and UV light resources. Further, the company engages in research, development, manufacture, and sale of photomasks for manufacturing flat panel displays. HOYA Corporation was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

business_summary: Noritsu Koki Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells audio equipment and peripheral products in Japan, China, the United States, Europe, Central and South America, the Middle East, Africa, and internationally. It offers DJ and club equipment, such as flat-top DJ CD players under the Pioneer DJ and AlphaTheta brands; and headphones and earbuds for sports, work, children, and gaming applications under the JLab brand. The company also provides pen nibs, cosmetics, and air freshener sticks; and metal parts for transportation and medical equipment. In addition, it offers personal technology products, such as web cameras and keyboards for remote working, as well as construction products and equipment, and related construction services. The company was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: A&D HOLON Holdings Company, Limited provides measurement technologies and products. The company provides measurement, control, and simulation systems; FFT, sound, and vibration analyzers; digital ultrasonic flaw detectors; meters; material testing machines; A/D D/A converters for semiconductor manufacturing equipment; electron guns; electronic balances; digital platform scales; weighing indicators; weighing controllers; various industrial weighing equipment; and load cells. It also offers weighing and measurement data processing systems; medical digital blood pressure monitors; various scales for medical use; home digital blood pressure meters; ultrasonic inhalers; electron beam photomask pattern dimension measuring equipment, and electron beam photomask inspection equipment. In addition, the company engages in business and asset management; and real estate management. The company was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

中でも主力製品のCD-SEMは今や、高機能化と小型化が進むパソコンやスマートフォン、 デジタル家電を支える半導体の回路原板（フォトマスク）の高度化・安定化に不可欠のものとなっています。 今後は世界でもトップクラスのテクノロジーをデジタル社会の進化のためにさらに結集。 研究開発、製造、販売、保守・メンテナンスの連携を強化し、産業・社会の期待に応えていきます。 半導体関連事業の強み 顧客 国内外の大手半導体メーカー、フォトマスクメーカーを顧客に、グローバルに市場を広げています。 ノウハウ・技術力 半導体市場のトレンドや最先端顧客ニーズを取り入れながら、長年培った技術をさらに進化させ続けています。 将来性 今後、暮らしと社会のすみずみまでIoTが普及することが予測され、半導体関連産業にはさらなる発展が期待されています。 半導体関連事業は株式会社エー・アンド・デイ、株式会社ホロンの事業領域です。 製品詳細ページ ※ホロン事業サイトへ 株式会社ホロン 半導体 - フォトマスクの寸法測定装置 微細な回路パターンの寸法測定に最適な電子ビーム技術 製品詳細ページ ※ホロン事業サイトへ business_summary: Okamoto Glass Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells special-purpose glass for industrial use and multi-layer film evaporation products. The company operates through Optical Business, Lighting Business, Functional Thin Film and Glass Business, and Other segments. The Optical Business segment manufactures and sells fly-eye lenses and reflectors for digital cinema projectors. The Lighting Business segment manufactures and sells glass for automobile headlights, fog lights; and glass products for general lighting. The Functional Thin Film and Glass Business segment manufactures and sells durable silver mirrors; glass polarizers; and decorative deposition on glass containers, and liquid crystal displays in cockpits, as well as manufactures and sells vapor deposition onto surface glass and frit. It also produces glass products, such as dental mirrors, and door glass for washing machines. In addition, the company offers glass materials, glass molded items, optical/functional coating products, glass ball/ oceanic spacecraft products, glass powder, uv-filter, decoration, and other products. Its products are used in mobility, display, telecommunication, sensor/IOT, medical, illumination, energy, and infrastructure/residence applications. Okamoto Glass Co., Ltd. was founded in 1928 and is headquartered in Kashiwa, Japan.

business_summary: Asahi Intecc Co., Ltd. engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of medical devices in Japan, the United States, Europe, China, and internationally. The company operates through the Medical and Device segments. It provides percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) guide wires, guiding catheters, balloon catheters, and penetration catheters for cardiology; peripheral guide wires, IVR guide wires, micro catheters, and cerebrovascular system guide wires for peripheral vascular, abdominal vascular, and cerebrovascular systems; and catheters for angiography. The company also offers OEM ODM service services for medical devices; and medical and industrial components, such as wire rope, coils, coatings, tubes, terminal processing products, synchronous round belt, and flexible shaft. In addition, it develops, manufactures, and sells ultra-fine stainless steel wire ropes. The company was formerly known as Asahi Mini Rope Sales Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Asahi Intecc Co., Ltd. in July 1988. Asahi Intecc Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Seto, Japan.

business_summary: Medikit Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells medical devices related to blood vessels and blood in Japan and internationally. business_summary: Canon Inc., together with its subsidiaries, develops, produces, sells, and services various printing, medical, imaging, and industrial equipment in Japan, the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Oceania. It operates through four segments: Printing Business Unit, Medical Business Unit, Imaging Business Unit, and Industrial Business Unit. The company offers digital continuous-feed and cut-sheet, large-format, and document and laser multifunction printers, as well as office multifunction devices, laser image scanners, calculators, and document solutions; and CT and ultrasound diagnostic scanners, x-ray diagnostic and MRI equipment, digital radiography, ophthalmology equipment, in-vitro diagnostic systems and reagents, and healthcare IT solutions. It also provides interchangeable lens and compact digital cameras, lenses, compact photo printers, MR systems, network cameras, digital cinema and video cameras, and broadcasting equipment, as well as video management and image analysis software; and semiconductor and FPD exposure equipment, organic EL display manufacturing equipment, vacuum thin film deposition equipment, and die bonding equipment, as well as handheld terminals and document scanners. In addition, the company offers functional and evaporation materials; optical paints, adhesives, and crystals; contact image sensors; printed wiring boards; vacuum components; microwave/power grid tubes; radiation detectors; and x-ray tubes, panel detectors, and image intensifiers. It sells its products under the Canon brand name through resellers and distributors. The company was formerly known as Canon Camera Company, Inc. and changed its name to Canon Inc. in March 1969. Canon Inc. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Ota, Japan.

business_summary: IMV Corporation manufactures and sells vibration simulation systems and measuring systems in Japan, Asia, Europe, the United States of America, and internationally. The company offers vibration simulation systems; test and solution services; and measuring devices, such as vibration measuring and monitoring devices, earthquake monitoring devices, and environmental reliability evaluation systems. It also offers quality control services to automobiles, aerospace, defense, and electronics industries. In addition, it provides vibration controllers; rental vibration testing machine; seismometers; vibration pick-up and sensors; and insulation degradation evaluation test equipment. It also develops, produces, repairs, and maintains vibration and environmental test systems. In addition, it offers test house, measuring analysis, and other consulting services for vibration tests. business_summary: Citizen Watch Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells watches and related components worldwide. It operates through three segments: Watch Business, Machine Tool Business, and Device Business. The company offers equipment and wall clocks; machine tools; and devices and components, such as compact automotive components, crystal units, miniaturized motors, LEDs for lighting, printers, and healthcare equipment under brands such as Citizen, Bulova, and Frederique Constant. It also provides technical services. Citizen Watch Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Nishitokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Rhythm Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells clocks in Japan. It offers living ware/clocks, such as wall, table, hall, cuckoo, and magic motion clocks for general consumers, as well as small fans and compact humidifiers; and precision parts for industrial use, as well as connected terminals. The company also provides solenoid coils for vehicles, terminal blocks, stamped/resin molds, stamped/resin molds/winding/welding/exterior molding products, terminal/molding products, and various insert parts, as well as parts processing and assembly OEM services; and in-vehicle cameras for trucks and linear motion guides. Further, it offers desk, alarm, digital, and other equipment clocks. The company was formerly known as Rhythm Watch Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Rhythm Co.,Ltd. in October 2020. Rhythm Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Saitama, Japan.

business_summary: Japan Tissue Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the regenerative medicine business in Japan. The company operates through Regenerative Medicine Product, Regenerative Medicine Contract, and Lab Site Project segments. It offers autologous cultured epidermis, cartilage, corneal epithelium, and oral mucosal epithelium to medical institutions for the purpose of medical treatment. The company also provides tissue-engineered medical products. In addition, it offers EPI-MODEL, a reconstructed human epidermis model. Further, the company offers regenerative medicine contract development and manufacturing services. The company was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Gamagori, Japan. Japan Tissue Engineering Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Teijin Limited.

business_summary: Daiken Medical Co., Ltd. engages in the planning, development, manufacturing, and sales of anesthesia-related and hospital infection prevention products in Japan and internationally. The company offers suction devices and PCA device; balloon type projector and syringe injector disposable infusion pumps; double lumen bronchial tube and disposable pulp system; syringe pump; handwashing water system and dispenser; wiper towel; and breath warm, sterimatt, and wet disinfectant mats. It is also involved in manufacture, sale, and trading of medical equipment. It sells its products under the COOPDECH brand name. Daiken Medical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1968 and is headquartered in Izumi, Japan.

business_summary: CellSeed Inc. engages in the cell sheet regenerative medicine business in Japan, the rest of Asia, and Europe. It operates through Regenerative Medicine Support Business and Cell Sheet Regenerative Medicine Business segments. The company is involved in commercializing regenerative medicine using cell sheets, which include autologous and allogeneic chondrocyte sheets. It also offers regenerative medicine contract services comprising contract development and manufacturing; contract manufacturing and consulting for specified cell-based products; and training and education in cell culturing technology services. In addition, the company provides UpCell, a temperature-responsive cell cultureware for cell sheet engineering; RepCell, a temperature-responsive cell cultureware for cell collection; HydroCell, a low cell binding cultureware; ThermoPlate III, a heating element made of a transparent glass plate; cellZscope, an automated cell monitoring system; and cell sheet support products. CellSeed Inc. was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Koto, Japan.

CYBERDYNE Inc. engages in robot-related business in Japan, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific countries. The company offers Hybrid Assistive Limb (HAL) for medical use in lower limb and single joint type; non-medical well-being HAL for lower limb type, single joint type, medicalcare pit, HALTREAD, All-in-One, HAL lumber type for labor support; cleaning robots; transportation robots for various transportation tasks in factories, offices, and other indoor environments; Acoustic X, a high speed light pulse LED array light source that enables real time photoacoustic imaging; and CYIN for living support, which is an novel interface that uses biological information that can be controlled voluntarily outside of muscle activities. It also provides Cybernics Treatment, a treatment to improve and regenerate wearer's function for spinal cord injury, stroke; and HAL based iBF Theory for human brain-nerve-musculoskeltal functions. In addition, the company provides medical care, nursing care, welfare, daily living and heavy work, and entertainment industries. CYBERDYNE Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Tsukuba, Japan.

business_summary: Dreambed Co.,Ltd. engages in the design, development, manufacture, and sale of mattresses, beds and bed frames, living room sofas, beddings, and interior furnishings in Japan. The company also provides duvet covers and sheets, bed pads, futons, pillows, bed accessories, sofa beds, pairing pads, and other products. It also installs waterbeds. The company sells its products under Dream Bed, Serta, King Koil, ruf, Ligne Roset, and Water World brands. It offers its products to individuals, furniture retailers and stores, department stores, hotels, other accommodation facilities, home builders, specialty stores, and bed manufacturers through dealers, shops and showrooms, and online. Dreambed Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

Colan Totte.Co.,Ltd. develops and sells home magnetic therapy devices under the Colantotte brand in Japan and internationally. The company offers magnetic therapy devices and health care products, such as chain and loop necklaces, innerwear, room wear, and other products, as well as supporters and clothing products. It also provides coverage wear, magnetic pillows, leg warmers, and eye masks. In addition, the company offers sports-related products to domestic sales agents and retailers. It sells its products directly through wholesale and e-commerce website and mall, and retail managed stores. Colan Totte.Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Bushiroad Inc. engages in the entertainment and sports businesses in Japan, the United States, rest of Asia, and internationally. It is also involved in the planning, development, production, and sale of trading card and digital games; planning, creation, and production of comics and anime programs; the planning and production of music content and pro-wrestling events; and the operation of a voice actor office, as well as merchandising and advertising agency businesses. In addition, the company provides Bushiroad Main IP and TCG products, including CardFight!! Vanguard, Weiß Schwarz, BanG Dream!, Revue Starlight, NEW JAPAN PRO-WRESTLING, and STARDOM; organizes trading card game tournaments and events; and develops and releases trading card game supplies, such as card sleeves and rubber playmats. Further, it plans, manages, and distributes mobile, online, and console games under the BUSHIROAD GAMES brand name; offers music software, such as music CDs, live and stage videos, and Blu-ray theatrical versions; and manages live music and music-related events, live viewing, and online streaming, as well as stage production. Additionally, the company creates and distributes character goods to toy stores, general retailers, and hobby shops; provides capsule toys, prizes, and promotional events; and offers concert merchandise, which includes light sticks, t-shirts, and towels, as well as voice actor goods and arcade prizes. Bushiroad Inc. was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Nakano, Japan.

business_summary: Kowa Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries,manufactures and sells nursing care products and welfare equipment under the Tacaof, AURULA, and GENTIL MARRONE brands in Japan. It operates through Nursing Care Products and Welfare Equipment Manufacturing and Sales Business, Nursing Care Service Business, and EC Business segments. The company offers walking aids, silver cars, walking aid carts, walking sticks, shoes, handrails, bathing aids, excretion care, flooring, push carts, walkers, mobility scooters, canes, bathing and toileting supplies, food and oral care, and life support products. Kowa Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

ISO認定を取得していますので、高品質なプレカットをご提供いたします。また、合法木材供給事業者認定を受けており、安心してご使用いただけます。 在来工法、2×4工法、金物工法、端柄プレカットとビルダー様、工務店様の建設現場の負担が軽減され、事前にプレカットすることで、現場での廃材が少なく済むなど環境にも優しい手法で、安心してご対応いただけます。 在来軸組工法 01 プレカット加工では、木材加工の工程をコンピューター制御によって機械が加工をします。 そのため、大幅な工期短縮と人件費等のコストダウンが可能となります。 自由度が高く、オーダーメイドが可能。 プレカットにより精度が高く、通常より工期を短くできます。 Feature 01 品質のばらつきがない高品質な接合部分（仕口）を作ることができる。 Feature 02 建築に必要な資材量が明確なので、資材量に無駄がない。 Feature 03 建築現場での加工作業がなくなり、木屑等の産業廃棄物が削減される。 Feature 04 大工職人が１日かかる作業を僅か10分程度（資材量の調達やCADの工程）で加工することができる。 ツーバイフォー工法 02 従来のツーバイフォー工法による住宅建築では、建築現場において材木を切断して枠材とし、その枠材と合板から作成した壁や床を構成する壁パネル、床パネル（面材）を組上げて建てていく方法が主流でした。 当社では、在来軸組工法におけるプレカット加工のノウハウにより、材木の切断やパネルの作成を機械化し、在来軸組工法と同様に高い生産性により、建築現場における大幅な工期短縮とコストダウンを可能としております。 business_summary: Platz Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells care beds, mattresses, and other add-on equipment in Japan. The company's products include nursing care beds, hospital beds, care facility beds, and accessories. The company also offers sales of electric medical care beds and related equipment, and processing and sales of urethane foam. It serves retailers of medical devices and nursing care goods, as well as furniture shops. The company was formerly known as Kyushu Waken ltd. and changed its name to Platz Co., Ltd. in June 1995. business_summary: JAPAN Creative Platform Group Co., Ltd. engages in the creative services business in Japan. The company involved in commercial, publication, and special printing; web production; multimedia planning and production, surface treatment, and other related business; provision of supplement and promotional products; planning, manufacturing, and sale of packaging materials; offset and value-added printing; metal processing mold metal printing; surface processing; sign display; planning and production of sp tool; media management; planning and manufacturing of package fixtures; print processing, binding, shipping, management, and other related services; binding of magazines, books, textbooks, weekly magazines, catalogs, calendars, etc.; foil stamping relief plates and pad printing plates manufacturing; and operates an advertising agency. It also produces 3DCG/digital, Web/interactive, and 2D/3D digital content; provides website construction and content development; sales promotion consulting; production; art printing; gallery management; brand strategy planning, visual production, and consulting; model management, casting, promotion; magazine/book publishing/web media/content marketing; photo studio management; multilingual translation, document creation and content management; editing; sales promotion; sells educational materials and ICT equipment; communication development; planning and production of cg and in-house content services; designs, manufactures, and sells digital audio equipment, as well as plans, designs, and constructs video and audio systems. In addition, the company offers stationery and capsule toys, cosmetic pouches and bags for adult women, paper stationery, character figurines, chocolate, lucky charms and gifts, and novelty. Further, it engages in bookbinding business. The company was founded in 1972 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Tokyo Board Industries Co., Ltd. engages in manufacturing and sells particleboard and provides comprehensive wood environmental solutions in Japan. The company's main business involves processing wood waste generated by the construction and logistics industries, as well as intermediate waste processing companies, and recycling it into wood chips that are used as raw materials for manufacturing particleboards under the EVA board brand. The company also offers particle boards and plywood products. In addition, the company offers in the collection and transportation of industrial waste; and general freight transportation businesses, as well as management and operation of shopping facilities. Tokyo Board Industries Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

やがて、新木場やその周辺から木材を取り扱う会社が減るにつれ、原材料の確保が困難になり、そこで「もったいない」と着目したのが木質廃棄物です。 平成３年、日本で初めて木質廃棄物直接処理によるパーティクルボードの製造をスタートし、ボード業界のパイオニアとして躍進してまいりました。 平成１２年の「廃棄物の処理及び清掃に関する法律」改定の後押しもあり、現在ではマンション現場にパーティクルボードを納め、同時に木質廃棄物を回収、それを工場に持ち帰ってパーティクルボードに再生させ、また建設現場へ戻すという循環の輪を構築するまでにいたりました。 取引企業様にも、当社の「もったいない」の発想と「木質廃棄物はまだつかえるのではないか、我々はそれをマテリアルリサイクルすることを最優先すべきではないか」という考え方にご賛同いただき、地球環境負荷の低減に繋がるこの取組にご参加いただいていることに感謝いたします。 また平成２９年１０月には新木場工場に加え、当社の念願であった最新鋭の連続プレスを設備する佐倉工場を稼働させました。 パーティクルボードの生産能力を増強するだけでは無く製品開発を進め、次世代木質パネルとして用途を広げ、市場変化に柔軟に対応できる生産体制を構築し、新木場リサイクリング工場と共に益々地球温暖化改善事業を押し進める基盤が出来上がりました。 木材は燃やせばCO2が出ます。 カーボンニュートラルでは、植林すればCO2は±0ですが、実態は、50年以上の歳月をかけてせっかく樹木が吸収したCO2を、発電等の為に伐採し、一瞬で燃やして大気中に放出しているのです。 発電するために燃やすのは木材以外のゴミで充分です。 木材はできる限り木材として、炭素を固定したまま利用するのが環境に良いのです。 樹木は、人工的エネルギーを一切使うことなく、何十年も自然の力だけで大気中のCO2を削減しながら成長します。 それを人間がエネルギー資源として利用するために一瞬にして燃やしてCO2を大気中に戻してしまうのです。 私たちは木質廃棄物をマテリアルサイクルすることにより、長年かけて樹木が固定した炭素をCO2として再放出することなく新たな使命を与えることができます。 私たちは木質廃棄物を再生し、新たな木材製品価値を環境負荷の低減と共に生み出すことが出来ます。 地球上に存在する樹木や木材の絶対量を増やし続けることが、地球温暖化改善に繋がるのです。 資源循環（RECYCLE）の輪（RING）と、そして現時点でもリサイクルし続ける（～ING） これを我々はリサイクリングと言っています。 business_summary: Maeda Kosen Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of civil engineering materials, building materials, and non-woven fabrics in Japan. The company offers ademwalle, RRR, unit cap/green terrace, adem geopack/geostage, four track RS, reinforced embankment work, slope reinforcement work, step reduction work, mattress, laying materials, monitoring, and shigaraki work; and special resin netting for animal damage prevention, plastic mesh, ground reinforcement earthwork, recycled plastic precast frame, two-way high strength geogrid, rockfall protection reinforced earth wall, avalanche protection reinforced earth wall for steep slope countermeasures, disaster prevention fiber net, weather-resistant polyester netting, lightweight rigid fiber net, resin sheet for wind, snow, and sand protection. Further, it provides packaging and industrial materials; medical, sanitary, and hygiene supplies; automotive materials; bedding and daily necessities; cushioning material filter; rayon blend non-flammable material; chemical protective clothing mask; oil absorption sheet; and measures at evacuation shelters custom-made. Maeda Kosen Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Sakai, Japan.

business_summary: Furuya Metal Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells industrial-use precious metal products and temperature sensors in Japan, Asia, Europe, and North America. The company operates through five segments: Electronics, Thin Film, Thermal, Fine Chemicals/Recycling, and Supply Chain Support. The company offers various metals processing products, such as iridium crucibles and seed holders, reflectors, and after heaters; platinum (Pt) and Pt alloy glass melting equipment materials for melting optical and LCD glass; Pt crucibles, evaporation dishes, and boats; bead dishes, Pt cells, and tongs with Pt; mesh, sheets, foils, pipes, and wire products; iridium tools for friction stir welding; and thermocouples. It also provides precious metal sputtering targets for magnetic recording media, flat panel display, semiconductor, and electronic component applications; evaporation materials; and made-to-order sputtering services for magnetic recording, touch panels, non-volatile semiconductor memory, electric devices, and electric components, as well as patterning and thin film analysis services. In addition, the company offers vibration testers and parts palletizers under the IDEX brand; inorganic and organic compounds, and precious metal powders; and develops FT-eco catalyst, nano alloy, and metal powders; and recycling and refining products. Furuya Metal Co., Ltd. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

It is also involved in the manufacture and sale of prefabricated houses; leasing of temporary buildings; general construction; contracting of solar power generation systems; generation of power using natural energy; and operation of golf courses. The company was founded in 1950 and is headquartered in Fukuyama, Japan.

business_summary: BANDAI NAMCO Holdings Inc. develops entertainment-related products and services worldwide. It operates in four segments: Digital Business, Toys and Hobby Business, Video and Music Business, and Amusement Business. The company offers toys, capsule toys, cards, confectionery and foods, apparel, sundries, plastic models, prizes, stationery, and other products. It also provides planning, development, manufacturing, and sales of plastic models, toys for the mature fan base, character lottery products, and special amusement prizes; planning, development, production, and sales of character, fancy, schoolchildren's, creative, premium stationery, and other sundries; planning, development, and manufacturing of pachinko and pachislot machines, electronic-related equipment; and planning, design, and website production, event planning, and administration. In addition, the company offers procurement of amusement prizes and character lottery products for convenience stores; planning, distribution, and sales of entertainment content, such as network content and home video games, PC content; and development, manufacturing, and sales of visual substrates; planning and operation of other new businesses. Further, it provides the planning and production of animation products; copyrights and rights business; production and agency operations in sports entertainment; planning, production, and sales of indoor-use recreation products; and procurement, sales, importing, and exporting of toys. Additionally, the company involved in the distribution, customs brokerage, product inspection, product manufacturing support, truck freight, industrial waste collection and transportation, logistics management, warehouse operations, and vehicle maintenance activities. The company was formerly known as NAMCO BANDAI Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to BANDAI NAMCO Holdings Inc. in June 2014. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

business_summary: France Bed Holdings Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, provides medical services in Japan. The company operates in two segments, Medical Services Business, and Home Furnishing and Health Business. It engages in the manufacturing, procurement, rental, and retail/wholesale sale of medical and nursing care beds, as well as welfare equipment; supply of linen to medical and welfare facilities, as well as hotels; and provision of facility solutions for medical and welfare facilities. The company is also involved in the design of mattresses; operation of showrooms for product experience and sleep consultation; and supply of beds, mattresses, and related products to hotels, inns, and other lodging operators. In addition, it engages in the sale of sundries; exhibition sale of furniture, fashion, and jewelry; manufacturing and sale of assorted beds and beddings, as well as special needs and home health equipment; maintenance, inspection, and repair of nursing-care and special needs equipment; storage of products and control of inventory; long-term care insurance welfare equipment rental business; daily-life care services in specified facilities; communal living care services for elderly with dementia; rental housing for elderly; and home renovation for home care. business_summary: Endo Manufacturing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells golf club heads, metal sleeve products, automobile and two-wheeled vehicle parts, forged components, aircraft parts, and medical devices in Japan and internationally. The company offers automobile, two-wheeled vehicle, and agriculture machinery parts, such as connecting rods, suspensions, yokes, hub units, transmission, gears, shafts, cranks, shift forks, camshaft, and arm lifts; golf club iron heads; dynamic/static blades for large turbines, hydraulic cylinders and joint parts, hydraulic dampers and piston rods for rolling stock, rock crushing machinery parts, and linear guides. It also provides metal sleeve products, including fuser rollers, heating rollers, battery cases, motor covers, seamless belts, seamless rings, motor parts, drive belts, electronic parts, and optical parts; golf products, such as irons and wedges under the EPON GOLF brand. In addition, the company offers medical devices comprising hip stems, acetabulum cups, trauma plates, knee joint and femoral components, and shoulder joint stems; engine parts for aerospace field. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Tsubame, Japan.

business_summary: Kawase Computer Supplies Co., Ltd. provides print communication products and services in Japan. It offers data print services, variable printing, cloud-based data processing, business forms, and web to print solutions. The company also offers high-speed data, and on-demand printing solutions; and digital invoice delivery, and digital messaging delivery services. The company was formerly known as Kawase Shiko and changed its name to Kawase Computer Supplies Co., Ltd. in 1976. Kawase Computer Supplies Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1955 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Hagihara Industries Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells plastic and industrial machinery products in Japan, Indonesia, Asia, and internationally. The company offers synthetic resin processing products, including flat yarns, monofilaments, sheets and sandbags, commercial printing and masking adhesive tapes, meltac cloths, base fabric for flexible container bag, artificial turf and carpet backing cloths, and barchips. It also provides engineering products, such as slitters, rewinders, yarn winders, plastic recycled pellet manufacturing equipment, extruder-related equipment, and GX line. The company exports its products. Its products are used in disaster prevention, architecture and civil engineering, industry and livestock farming, and household goods applications. Hagihara Industries Inc. was incorporated in 1962 and is headquartered in Kurashiki, Japan.

business_summary: Almedio Inc. engages in the development, manufacturing and marketing of sub-materials for electronic parts, refractory materials, and related products in Japan. It operates through Insulation material business and Nano Material business segments. The Insulating Material segment offers ceramic, alumina, and biosoluble fiber; electric furnace and heater module; and molded products. The Nano Material segment develops, produces, and processes nanomaterial products, such as carbon nano fiber, carbon microfiber, synthetic graphene powder, CNF blended pellets for aviation / space, automobile, medical products, and sports / leisure goods industries. The company was formerly known as A-BEX and changed its name to Almedio Inc. in March 1997. Almedio Inc. was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Kunitachi, Japan.

business_summary: Avex Inc., an entertainment company, engages in the music, artist management, animation, visual content, and other businesses in Japan. It operates through music, anime & visual content, and overseas segments. The company plans, produces, and sells musical content; publishes and distributes music; and plans, produces, and manages concerts and events. It also manages artists, talents, and creators; operates and manages fan clubs; and sells tickets. In addition, the company is involved in planning, developing, and managing of e-commerce sites; planning, producing, sale, and distribution of digital content; planning and production of game software; supply of animation titles to video distribution services and film distribution activities, as well as plans, produces, and distributes entertainment content. The company was formerly known as Avex Group Holdings Inc. and changed its name to Avex Inc. in November 2017. Avex Inc. was incorporated in 1973 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Fukuvi Chemical Industry Co.,Ltd. engages in manufacturing, processing, and sale of synthetic resin products and inorganic compounds in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Construction Materials, CSE Business, Precision Machiney Business, Global Business, and Other segments. Eiji Fukasawa 「職人の技術×最先端の機械加工」で、トップシェアを獲得 当社は、ジュエリー生産量日本一を誇る山梨県に籍を置くジュエリーパーツ&鍛造ジュエリーメーカーです。ジュエリーパーツについては国内で50%、とくにイヤリングの金具については70%のシェアを獲得しており、ジュエリーについてはブライダル関連で主に用いられる鍛造技術に特化することで、期待に応える製品づくりを行ってまいりました。 ジュエリーを含む装飾品の歴史はとても古く、人類の誕生とともに始まったと言っても過言ではありません。古来、世界各国であらゆる職人の手によって作られてきたジュエリーですが、当社は職人の持つ技術に最先端の機械加工を掛け合わせることで、品質と量を同時に追求。ジュエリーパーツにおいては年間約1,000万点、製造が困難と言われる鍛造ジュエリーについては年間約3万点程度を生産し、国内屈指の技術力と生産力で製品を安定供給しています（2019年現在）。 ユーザー様、取引先様、従業員、子孫、地球環境を考えた製品づくり 事業を営む上で大切にしているのは、製品を身につけるユーザー様、当社の取引先様、従業員、私たちの子孫、そして地球環境にとって、フェアなものづくりをすること。すなわち、人と地球環境の両方に優しく、負荷が偏重することのない事業を心がけています。 現代に生きる私たちにとって、人と環境の両方にフェアであることは必須。これらの取り組みを通じて、私たちはサスティナブルなビジネスと経済、社会、さらには地球環境の創造を目指しています。 付加価値を高め、日本と世界のデファクトスタンダードに business_summary: Noda Corporation manufactures, processes, imports, and sells woody and inorganic building materials, medium-density fiberboard, and plywood products in Japan. The company provides building interior materials, including flooring, inner wall, fixture members, staircase members, framework, and step products; exterior substrate materials for motor use; and home furnishings and fixtures, such as interior and sliding doors, closets, opening frame members, front hall storage racks, home storage units, and other products, as well as handrail members. It also offers laminated wood bonded with braces and structural hi-best wood; and imports and sells ordinary, concrete forming, structural, and painted plywood, as well as coniferous plywood, south-sea lumber plywood, and other products. The company was formerly known as NODA PLYWOOD Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Noda Corporation in 1989. Noda Corporation was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

business_summary: Takano Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells office chairs and other office furniture, springs, exterior products, electronics-related products, and equipment for health and welfare in Japan and internationally. The company offers medical and healthcare equipment, including stretchers, wheelchairs, wheelchair cushions, walking aids, and others; exterior products comprising awnings, parasols, and multi-utility room products; office furniture, such as swivel chairs and conference room chairs; and health food products. It also provides solenoid actuators, including electromagnetic electrical components for various industrial equipment; spring and unit components comprising precision, wiring, and spiral springs; automatic optical inspection and measurement systems, such as LCD panel inspection system, battery-related material, and Web inspection systems; and in vitro diagnostic reagent. The company was formerly known as Takano Factory Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Takano Co.,Ltd. in 1973. Takano Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1941 and is headquartered in Kamiina, Japan.

当社はこれまで、全社を挙げて生成AIの業務実装を推進し、その取り組みを「第2回 生成AI活用成果報告会」や「役員向けAI経営講座」として社外にも発信してまいりました。AI活用を進める企業があえて「No AI」を掲げる背景には、AIが当たり前になる時代にこそ、一人ひとりが「自分の頭で考え、自分で決める力」を養う時間が必要であるという考えがあります。 長野県に本社を置く製造業として、今後も「製造業から『創造業』へ」の進化を担う次世代の育成に、地域とともに取り組んでまいります。 企画の背景 — AI活用を推進するからこそ、「No AI」 Loop（HITL）の原則を全社の共通言語として掲げ、最終判断と説明責任は人が担うという姿勢を繰り返し共有してまいりました。 AIを使いこなすほど、問われるのは人間自身の力です。膨大な選択肢を前に「何を選ぶのか」「なぜそれを選ぶのか」を決めるのは、最後まで人にしかできない仕事です。 本商品は、ピップ株式会社（本社：大阪府大阪市中央区、代表取締役社長：松浦 由治）の流通・販売網を通じ、全国のドラッグストア、ベビー用品専門店、およびオンラインショップ等にて順次、一般向け販売を開始することをお知らせいたします。 チャイルカップ（たまご） チャイルカップ（卵白） 本取り組みの背景とストーリー 「検査から日々の食事管理まで」アレルギー社会課題へのトータルアプローチ 当社は臨床検査薬事業において、これまで自動分析装置「SiLIS-100（サイリス-100）」（一般的名称：移動式免疫発光測定装置）を医療機関向けに提供し、迅速かつ正確なアレルギー原因物質の特定に貢献してまいりました。 昨今、乳幼児期におけるアレルギーへの配慮においては、「早期に適切な計画に基づき、原因となり得る食材を慎重に摂取していくこと」の重要性が注目されています。しかし、特に「たまご」や「卵白」の微量な計量や調理は、ご家庭において心理的・体力的に大きな負担となっていました。 そこで、医療機関向けに自動分析装置を展開する当社は、「アレルギーの早期発見（検査）だけでなく、検査後のご家庭における食事管理（対策）までトータルでサポートしたい」という強い想いから、株式会社ビー・ケースが開発した「チャイルカップ」の取り扱いを決定いたしました。 本商品を、日用品・ヘルスケア製品の卸売大手であるピップ株式会社の全国的な流通ネットワークに乗せることで、医療機関とご家庭をつなぎ、誰もが安心して乳幼児期の食事を進められる社会の実現を目指します。 取り扱い商品概要 商品名： チャイルカップ（たまご / 卵白） 製品特長： 慎重な離乳食の進め方に配慮した設計： しかし、検査の先にある『ご家庭でのアレルギーに配慮した日々の食事管理』において、多くの保護者様が不安を抱えている現状を目にしてきました。今回、ビー・ケース様の『チャイルカップ』を取り扱い、ピップ様の強力な販売網を通じて一般のご家庭にお届けすることで、医療と生活現場の双方から、アレルギーに配慮した食事管理に対する安心をご提供いたします。 【株式会社ビー・ケース コメント】 卵は栄養価のバランスが良く、離乳初期に取り入れることができますが、食物アレルギーの原因になりやすい食品です。『チャイルカップ』は赤ちゃんがはじめて卵を食べるときに、安心して召し上がられるように少量の卵を含んだ離乳食補助食品です。 エクステリア事業は、オフィス椅子のパイプ加工技術をベースに1982年に誕生しました。現在は、「オーニング」「パラソル」「跳ね上げ式門扉」など、ガーデンエクステリア製品を中心に事業を展開。それぞれ多彩なデザイン・バリエーションを備え、市場のニーズに対応しています。 今後は、タカノならではの強みを活かし、メカトロニクス・セキュリティー技術や電装を利用した付加価値の高い商品の開発に力を注いでまいります。また、リサイクル材を利用した商品の開発も活性化させていきます。 主要製品 技術紹介 施工例 タカノのオーニング もう一つの部屋（リビング） 主要製品 壁付け型オーニング 壁に直接設置するオーニング。支えるバーがないので、テーブルセットをたくさん置くレストランのようなところでは邪魔にならずに、すっきりとした空間が保てます。美術館のカフェなどのビジュアルを重視する空間での使用にも最適です。また、壁に設置するので、下にある構造物に制限されることはありません。ガーデンファニチャーが素敵に映える空間づくりに、ひと役かってくれるオーニングです。 自立型オーニング 建物自体に設置しない自立型のオーニングは、建物に傷をつけることなく設置が可能な、建築物に配慮したタイプです。レストランやカフェなどの店先のみならず、広いパブリックなスペースでも日よけとして活躍。日よけの効果を狙うだけでなく外の空間を室内の延長として取り込むことで、開放的で明るい印象をもたらします。集うスペースを広げることは、人が集まることにつながります。 大型パラソル 日差しをファッショナブルに遮ることができる大型のパラソルは、シンボリックな存在として、空間を華やかにデザインします。街中の店先ではヨーロッパの酒場のような活気が生まれ、自然の中では優雅なリゾート感を演出。また、広いスペースではパラソルを連ねることで空間の一体化も図ることができる、万能なアイテムです。 新提案・ガーデンエクステリア 憩いの空間を提供する多目的ハウス。 自然豊かな空間を生み出すデザインタープ。 ロビー、エントランス、ホールなどを豪華に演出する蘭ポッド。 ガーデンライフを彩るアイテムで、快適な空間をご提供します。 技術紹介 タカノ株式会社 エクステリア部門の製造技術をご紹介します。 エクステリア分野だけでなく、様々な分野の製造委託や共同開発をお受けしております。 アルミ加工技術（溶接・NC加工） NC加工機やプレス機、TIG溶接機を使用し、アルミ形材に関する様々な加工にお応えします。近隣の協力工場との連携により、複雑な曲げ加工等も対応可能です。 量産をはじめ、試作や小ロットも対応可能です。 ［NC加工機：5台、TIG溶接機：1台、プレス機他：多数］ レーザー裁断技術 ナイロン、ポリエステル、アクリル樹脂、厚紙、天然素材（綿）、木材板 等をレーザー加工（裁断/マーキング）することができます。 ※対応素材は5mm以下の薄物になります。 幅1.8M以下の大サイズを原反単位で対応可能です。 CAD図面からの裁断指示も可能です。 縫製技術 オーニングキャンバスの縫製をメインに行っており、5M前後の大型の縫製を得意としております。 丈夫なキャンパス生地の縫製を行っておりますので、厚物の縫製も正確で高い品質の仕上がりになります。 ［1本針本縫上下送りミシン：3台、2本針本縫総合送りミシン：2台］ ウェルダー加工技術 樹脂コートされた生地、塩ビシートの溶着が可能です。接合部の仕上がりもきれいで、屋外用カーテン、間仕切りなどに最適です。 ［最大加工面積：20mm×800mm（1ストローク当たり）］ 組立技術 エクステリア商材をはじめ多種多様な大・中型製品の組立てが可能です。 アルミ材は自社加工し、他部品についても取引先からの調達が可能です。 納期・品質管理を徹底した生産管理のもと、特注品から量産まで幅広く対応可能です。 開発・設計技術 アルミ形材の設計をはじめ、エクステリア製品他、完成品の設計を得意としております。特に電動・IoT・大型製品のノウハウがあります。 40年の経験を生かした品質・コスト・エコに配慮した設計を心がけています。 試作事例・OEM製品事例 オーニングには様々なパーツが組み込まれています。 アルミ形材、シート、キャンバスを使用した試作や特注品を請け負うことができます。 量産品での設計開発依頼、既存製品の加工・組立依頼等、お気軽にご相談ください。 開発から素材加工、組立、梱包までの一貫体制での対応が可能です。小ロット品や試作の製作も承ります。 施工例 様々なシーンで活躍するタカノのオーニングを具体的な施工事例を交えながらご紹介します。 ＞詳しくはこちら タカノのオーニング オーニングは、テラスや窓辺に設置し、直射日光を抑え、部屋に自然の空気を取り入れる事ができます。また収納もでき光を取り入れたい場合にも簡単に調節することが可能です。 窓の外で日差しをコントロール。そのため夏場のエアコン稼働率が大幅に縮減、約70％もエアコン稼働率を下げることが実証されています。直射日光を約2/3もカットしてくれるので、夏も涼しく省エネ効果もばっちりです。 business_summary: Nankai Plywood Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells interior building materials in Japan. business_summary: Sanko Gosei Ltd. engages in the molding and sale of plastic products and plastic molding dies in Japan and internationally. The company offers automotive, including molded parts, exterior parts, and battery parts; industrial equipment, such as information equipment, molding, insert molding, automatic assembly machine, assembly line, ultrasonic welding machine, and clean booth; and home applications, including commercial and home air conditioning parts, refrigerator parts, power conditioner, industrial battery parts, fuel cell parts, and mold production. The company also manufactures and sells synthetic resin moldings; manufactures, assembles and processes any or all kinds of mechanical and electrical parts; designs, manufactures and sells molds and tools for synthetic resin molding; plans, design, pilot, make and sell any or all kinds of industrial products; designs, manufacture and sell any or all kinds of industrial robots and automatic control of any or all kinds of machines and systems; and carry on all business in connection with the above sub-clauses. Its products are used in industrial electrical equipment, information and telecommunication appliances, automobiles, household appliances, housing equipment, and nursing care products. Sanko Gosei Ltd. was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Nanto, Japan.

プライバシーポリシー 富山県「令和8年度ものづくり企業のバイオ・医薬分野参入推進事業」に採択されました 2026年7月7日 当社は、公益財団法人富山県新世紀産業機構（TONIO）が実施する「令和8年度ものづくり企業のバイオ・医薬分野参入推進事業」に採択されました。 本事業では、当社が保有する特許技術である「ガス透過性金型」を活用し、医療・バイオ分野で需要が高まる使い捨てマイクロ流路チップの量産技術開発に取り組みます。 従来の樹脂成形技術では、金型内に残留する空気の影響により、樹脂を極めて細い流路の先端まで充填することが難しく、流路幅は10µm程度が限界とされていました。本研究では、当社独自のガス透過性金型技術により金型内部のガスを効率的に排出することで、従来比約1/10となる1µmレベルの極微細流路成形技術の確立を目指します。 本技術の実現により、従来は困難であった極微細マイクロ流路の安定成形と将来的な量産化に向けた技術基盤の構築を進めるとともに、富山県の医薬・バイオ関連産業の発展への貢献および新たな事業領域の創出を目指してまいります。 関連リンク 公益財団法人富山県新世紀産業機構（TONIO） 「令和8年度ものづくり企業のバイオ・医薬分野参入推進事業 採択結果」 採択結果はこちら バイオ・医薬分野参入推進事業 business_summary: Hokushin Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of medium density fiberboards in Japan. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Kishiwada, Japan.

Matsumoto Inc. engages in the printing business in Japan. The company offers graduation albums for schools; and manufactures general commercial printed materials, such as posters, catalogs, and brochures. It is also involved in internet-related businesses, including digital photo albums, self-publishing, print mail-order sales, and photo print sales activities. business_summary: Kimoto Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of various film and paper products in Japan and internationally. It offers a range of films, including hard coat films for membrane switches; hard coat, optical, shatter-proof, decorative, and conductive films; formable hard-coated films; light diffusion and reflection films; printed circuit board films; light-blocking films; pressure-sensitive adhesive films for industrial use; molding films; display inkjet films; transfer films; antibacterial and antiviral films; environmentally friendly films; CAD inkjet films; window films; and functional liquid films. The company also provides a variety of services, such as editing and processing of point cloud data, creation of 3D modeling data, geospatial information data creation, digital image data processing, spatial photography, software and system development, manufacturing DX solution proposals, AR/VR/MR services, digital twin system construction, data cloud management services, data storage services, online quotation services, work style reform consulting, manufacturing DX consulting, and book publishing. In addition, it is involved in the planning, design, and development of communication tools. Furthermore, the company offers spatial information and image editing/system development services for 3D point cloud data acquired from laser surveying, as well as 2D map data used for surveys and land registration. The company is also involved in the development and sale of software, production and sale of agricultural products, and consulting businesses. Kimoto Co., Ltd. was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Inabe, Japan.

business_summary: TOPPAN Holdings Inc. develops solutions based on its printing technologies in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It operates through three segments: Information & Communication, Lifestyle & Industry, and Electronics. The Information & Communication segment offers securities in general, bankbooks, cards, business forms, catalogs, and other advertising and promotional printed materials, magazines, books, business process outsourcing, and other publications services. The Lifestyle & Industry segment provides soft packaging and paper containers, plastic moldings, inks, transparent barrier films, decorative sheets, wallpaper, and other building materials. The Electronics segment offers LCD color filters, TFT LCDs, anti-reflection films, photomasks, and semiconductor package products. The company was formerly known as Toppan Inc. and changed its name to TOPPAN Holdings Inc. in October 2023. TOPPAN Holdings Inc. was founded in 1900 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

business_summary: Nissha Co., Ltd. engages in industrial materials, devices, medical technologies, information and communication, and pharmaceutical and cosmetics businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers decorative film-molded parts, such as in-mold decoration technology and electronics, transfer foil, molding, CMF design sample book products, commercial printing; and sustainable materials, including metallized paper and board, and sustainable molded products. It is involved in the provision of touch, force, and gas sensors; the design and manufacture of medical technologies; development and manufacture of pharmaceuticals and quasi-drugs; design, development and manufacturing service of products such as surgical instruments for minimally invasive treatments and medical wearable sensors; and manufacturing and distributing patient monitoring and medical surgical devices. In addition, the company offers publication, high-definition digital archive photography, and fabric printing products and services; contract development and manufacturing film types of pharmaceuticals, such as oral thin films and transdermal patches; development and manufacturing of over-the-counter (OTC) and prescription drugs under contract manufacturing (CDMO); and dissolving microneedle patches; as well as produces and sells business media, including industrial recording materials and ticket/card materials. It serves mobility, mobile devices, home appliance, medical, food and consumer goods, cosmetics, and industrial equipment markets. The company was formerly known as Nissha Printing Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nissha Co., Ltd. in 2017. Nissha Co., Ltd. was founded in 1929 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

business_summary: ZACROS Corporation manufactures and sells products for wellness environmental solutions, information electronic, and industrial infrastructure in Japan and internationally. It operates through four segments: Wellness Business; Environmental Solutions Business; Information and Electronics Business; and Industrial Infrastructure Business. The company offers wellness products, including MediTect IV Bag, a non-adsorbing, low-leaching packaging for ready-to-use (RTU) drugs; BioPhas, a customized service that is used in single-use products for biopharmaceuticals manufacturing; and Total Thrombus-formation Analysis System, a flow chamber system. It also provides environmental solutions, such as flexible refill pouches; liquid containers; and high performance / high clean packaging. In addition, the company offers protective films; coating commissioned processing services; and free standing electrode, as well as adhesive films, release liners, tab seal film, and industrial laminate film. Further, it engages in industrial infrastructure activities. The company was formerly known as Fujimori Kogyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to ZACROS Corporation in October 2024. ZACROS Corporation was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.

business_summary: Muto Seiko Co., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells plastic parts in Japan, Vietnam, China, Taiwan, Thailand, rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through Plastic Molding Business and Printed Circuit Board Business segments. The company offers plastic parts for digital home appliances, such as digital and video cameras; for center panel units, including car navigation systems, air conditioners, and audio equipment; and for automotive-related parts, which include ETCs. It also provides molds for injection molding and pressing. In addition, the company offers printer paper feed parts and electronic pens; and technical support services. Further, it engages in the design, inspection, and sale of printed circuit boards. Muto Seiko Co. was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Kakamigahara, Japan.

business_summary: Mirai Industry Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of electrical equipment materials, water supply and drainage equipment materials, and gas equipment materials in Japan. The company provides flexible synthetic resin conduit, rigid polyvinyl chloride conduits, cable wiring switch boxes, and underground conduits. It also manufactures and sells wiring devices, including switches and outlets; manufactures and sells labor-saving machines, resin molding molds, and vending machines; and manufactures and sells synthetic resin materials. In addition, the company is involved in the general construction; building and ancillary equipment maintenance and management; construction consulting businesses; and agricultural materials. Further, it engages in the road freight transportation, data center, and cable TV activities, as well as provision of fireproof components and plumbing equipment. Mirai Industry Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1965 and is headquartered in Wanouchi, Japan.

business_summary: Nippi,Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells collagen and gelatin products in Japan, Thailand, rest of Asia, North America, and internationally. It operates through Collagen Casing Business, Gelatin-Related Business, Cosmetics Related Business, Leather-Related Business, Pipes and Real Estate Business, and Food and Other Businesses segments. The company offers collagen casings for use in various fields, including sausages, other food, medicine and medical care, and cosmetics; gelatin products, which is used in food, pharmaceuticals, and photo films; collagen peptides for the food and pharmaceutical industries; leather products for the automotive industry; and collagen-based cosmetics, skin and health care, and functional food products. It also provides functional polymers comprising Nippi Linker cross-linked polyvinyl chloride (PVC) films and sheets, and cross-linked PVC compounds for electric wires and cables; and Nippi V PVC quilting cloth and foam products. In addition, the company offers pet supplements, and test regents and kits for animals; life science products, such as low endotoxin gelatin products, recombinant human laminin protein for iPS cell culture substrates, lab equipment and supplies, and reagents for research; and synthetic products, such as plastics and compounds. Further, it engages in the development of urban renewal projects; and provision of management, consulting, and real estate rental services. The company was formerly known as The Japan Leather Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippi,Incorporated in February 1974. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Adachi, Japan.
