business_summary: Shoei Foods Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, procures, processes, manufactures, sells, and imports food products in Japan, China, the United States, and internationally. The company offers fruits, including prunes, raisins, cranberries, blueberries, strawberries, mandarin oranges, lemons, mangoes, grapefruits, figs, dates, cherries, apples, apricots, grapes, raspberries, goji berries, pineapples, papayas, goldenberries, gingers, bananas, cherry tomatoes, aloes, mixed fruits, peaches, and pears; and nuts such as almonds, almond milk, walnuts and processed walnut products, macadamia nuts, cashews, hazelnuts, pecan nuts, pistachio nuts, coconuts, pine nuts, and sunflower and pumpkin seeds. It also provides confectionery and bread making ingredients comprising candied chestnuts, chestnut pastes, processed chestnut products, candied plums, sweet potato and chocolate processed products, maple syrups, baked confectioneries, powdered sugar, almond frost, custard powder, nata de coco and tapioca, fruit jam and filling, and fruit pickles and puree; and dairy products, which include butter, imported mozzarella and cream cheese, imported dairy products and preparations, condensed and fermented milks, cafe and confectionery ingredients, dairy lactic acid bacteria beverages, powder products, reconstituted concentrated milk, formulated milk powder, soft mix, and caramel products. In addition, the company offers foodservice ingredients, such as pasta, olive oil, tomatoes, table olives, cones, tuna processed products, processed potato products, mushrooms, steamed beans, fruit magic dolce and sauce, dessert syrups and jellies, and topping ingredients; and home products comprising prune small bags, nuts and seeds sachets, dried fruit packets, and other retail items. Further, it operates and manages walnut, prune, and almond farms. The company was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Taito, Japan.

business_summary: Kanaden Corporation operates as an electronics solutions company in Japan and internationally. It provides factory automation systems, including sequencers, inverters, AC servos, robots, and other control and drive systems; wireless sensors, total production control systems, and direct current power supplies; electrical discharge and laser processing machines; power semiconductors and network ICs and memory; connectors and connectors for wired LAN; and wireless modules and solutions. The company provides building facilities equipment, such as hands-free authentication devices, air conditioning management system central controllers, uninterrupted power supplies, elevators, escalators, and led lightings; air conditioner, air-cooling heat pump chiller, refrigeration and cooling system, and open showcase; and net zero energy building Solutions. In addition, it offers video solution systems, security systems, telecommunications equipment, electronic medical care systems, and LED display systems; semiconductors, electronic device, and wireless solution; electric products for rolling stock, substation equipment for receiving electric power, and telecommunication equipment, as well as train vision systems, air conditioning equipment, etc.; and road display panels, LED road lighting fixtures, in-vehicle video recording systems, emergency radio systems, etc., as well as quick charger for electric vehicles. The company was formerly known as Kanagawa Electric Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kanaden Corporation in October 1990. Kanaden Corporation was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Ryoden Corporation sells factory automation (FA) systems, cooling and heating systems, information and communication technologies (ICT), building systems, smart-agri, green network, healthcare, and electronics businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers industrial mechatronics/machining equipment, vision sensors, power receiving and distribution equipment, power controllers, drive devices, cloud based integrated monitoring and control, sensors, transformers and static capacitors, edge computing products, industrial robots, displays and SCADA, deep learning products; HAVC and residential equipment, and equipment for low-temperature applications. It also provides beacons, indoor positioning systems, ICT components, and IoT and monitoring solutions; elevators and escalators, security camera systems, and finger authentication devices; and building, parking-facility, and transport equipment. In addition, the company offers semiconductors, communication equipment and modules, optical devices, circuit boards, finished metal products, coils and transformers, connectors and sockets, capacitors, plastics, liquid crystal oscillators, textile products, cast and wrought products, resistors, power sources and batteries, cables and heaters, chemical products, fuses, filters, motors, and other electrical and electronic products. Further, it provides image data management and operational support systems for health care business. It serves construction, automotive, consumer, power and energy, information and communication, transportation, food, and healthcare industries. The company was formerly known as Ryoden Trading Company, Limited and changed its name to Ryoden Corporation in June 2016. Ryoden Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Narasaki Sangyo Co., Ltd. engages in the sale of electric machinery and equipment, building materials, fuels, and shipping-related operations in Japan. It offers measuring and monitoring supervisory control equipment; air conditioning and sanitation equipment, freezing and refrigerating equipment, elevators, power receiving/transforming facilities, emergency home power generators, power supply systems, parking lot equipment, large-scale mapping devices, building management systems, and security systems; FA and high-performance materials; and industrial equipment and agricultural implements. The company also sells construction machinery such as milling machine, rotary snow plow, asphalt finisher, vibrating roller, concrete pump, silent piler, pile driver, and telescopic crane; construction materials; and energy department provide petroleum products to industry and households and gas station management. In addition, it is involved in Shipping operations at ports, warehouse management, domestic coastal shipping, boat leasing, irregular overseas shipping and transportation, and customs clearance; sea transport agency; air service agency; and motor truck operations. Further, the company sells automobile parts, liquefied petroleum gas, and other high-pressure gases; and repairs automobiles. The company was formerly known as Narasaki Sangyo Kaiun K.K. and changed its name to Narasaki Sangyo Co., Ltd. in 2002. Narasaki Sangyo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

business_summary: Nipro Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the medical devices, pharmaceuticals, and pharma packaging businesses. Its Medical-Related business develops, manufactures, and sells injection and infusion products, artificial organ-related products, functional products, dialysis products, cell cultures, hospital products, diabetic products, and pharmaceuticals comprising generic and kit products; and manufactures medical equipment, including dialysis medical device products; and operates dialysis and training centers. The company's Pharmaceutical-Related business engages in the contract manufacturing of pharmaceutical products with containers for combination products, including injectable kit products consigned by other pharmaceutical companies; and provides injectable, oral drugs products. In addition, its Pharma Packaging business offers pharmaceutical packaging containers and glass tubing, such as molded components for vials, syringes, rubber stoppers, and devices used to administer pharmaceuticals; and glass for thermos bottles, lighting and containers for combination products, glass equipment, as well glass for ampoules. Further, the company serves customers in Japan, the Americas, Europe, and rest of Asia. Nipro Corporation was founded in 1947 and is based in Settsu, Japan.

business_summary: Iwatani Corporation engages in supplying gases and energy in Japan, China, Taiwan, South Korea, Singapore, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, Vietnam, the United States, and Australia. It operates through three segments: Integrated Energy, Industrial Gases & Machinery, and Materials. The Integrated Energy segment offers LPG for household, commercial, and industrial use; LPG-supply equipment and facilities; LNG; petroleum products; household kitchen appliances; and home energy components, Ene farm, GHP, daily necessities, portable gas cooking stoves, cassette gas canisters, mineral water, detergent, health foods, and electricity. The Industrial Gases & Machinery segment provides air separation gases, hydrogen, helium, other specialty gases, gas supply facilities, welding materials, welding and cutting equipment, industrial robots, pumps and compressors, disaster prevention equipment, and high-pressure gas containers; and semiconductor manufacturing equipment, electronic component manufacturing equipment, factory automation systems, machine tools and sheet metal machinery, pharmaceutical, and environmental equipment, as well as operates facilities for hydrogen stations. The Materials segment provides PET resins, biomass fuels, battery-related materials, mineral sands, rare metals, rare earths, electronics and semiconductor materials, stainless steel, aluminum, and electronic display film. Iwatani Corporation was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: Nice Corporation distributes building materials and housing equipment in Japan. It operates through two segments, Construction Materials and Housing. The company manufactures and processes wood products; distributes lumber, pre-cut products, exterior walls and roofs, and energy-related and technostructure materials; manufactures and sells prefabricated housing and interior materials, laminate products, doors, wood chips, and organic fertilizers; and constructs and sells lumber and exterior walls. It also engages in lumber sawing, processing, and sales; logging, tree selection, and other log production; afforestation and forestry; planning and sale of bathroom products; export of lumber; logistics; and sale and installation of building materials, sashes, and exteriors. In addition, the company is involved in management and renovation of apartments and buildings; non-life insurance agency; operation, rental brokerage, intermediation, and sale of real estate; real estate management and administration consulting; and design, construction, mediation, and contracting of custom-built homes, shrines, temples, tea houses, and large wooden structures. Further, it engages in the construction of detached houses; contracting for construction of housing equipment; development and sale of business software for the lumber and housing industries; cable TV broadcasting and communications; telecommunications; IT solutions; support services and maintenance for the accumulation and utilization of housing history information; shared services; and olive farm operations. The company was formerly known as Nice Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to Nice Corporation in March 2020. Nice Corporation was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

business_summary: Nichimo Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells fish products in Japan, Korea, China, North America, South America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers surimi, and fresh and frozen fish products, and processed and value-added products; fishing nets, gears, ropes, twines, fishing machinery and vessels, and aquaculture feeds; processed cultivated fish products; food processing machines and other related machinery; nori processing and tofu making machines; and fermented soybean and health food products. It also provides synthetic resins, packaging materials and supplies, and agricultural materials; logistics and distribution services; and temporary staffing services, as well as engages in real estate activities. Nichimo Co., Ltd. was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Kyokuto Boeki Kaisha, Ltd. primarily operates as an engineering trading company in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Industrial equipment related department, Industrial materials related department, and Machine parts related department segments. It is involved in the import, export, wholesale, sale, and agent services related to machinery, equipment, materials, measuring instruments, gauges, vessels, vehicles, hardware, chemical engineering products, explosives, foodstuffs, textiles and textile products, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, and other general merchandise; aircrafts; space appliances and parts; computers and parts; power generation facilities, control devices, and monitoring devices and parts; bridges; boilers; turbines; communication systems; pollution control devices, such as water treatment devices and atmospheric contamination analyzer; devices related to natural resource exploration, analysis and excavation, and parts; alcoholic beverages and drinking water; agrochemicals, herbicides, feeds, feed additives, fertilizers, and fertilizer additives and related materials; and fuel, medical supplies, fuel cells, and related materials. The company also provides repair and maintenance services related to the machinery, devices, and facilities; engages in acquisition, planning, licensing, sale, repair, maintenance, and brokering of computer system technology and software; and computer-based information processing and provision, and advertising activities. In addition, it offers general leasing, transportation, construction contracting, temporary staffing, life insurance, and non-life insurance agency services. Kyokuto Boeki Kaisha, Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

business_summary: Astena Holdings Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells medicine-related products in Japan. It operates through four segments: Fine Chemicals, Health & Beauty Care, Medical, Industrial Chemicals Segment, and Social Impact Business Segment. The company's Fine Chemical segment offers value chain of pharmaceutical development and manufacturing; raw ingredient procurement; CMC research and development; commercial API production, and investigational drugs; contract manufacturing; new drug development; and drug discovery incubation business, as well as manufactures a variety dosage forms, including injectable, solid, semi-solid, and liquid dosage forms on contract. Its Health & Beauty Care, Food Segment provides OTC drugs, functional food ingredients, and cosmetic ingredients; butylene glycol, natural plant extract, sodium acetylated hyaluronate, tea-tree oil, yeast extract, dehydrate potato, tomato powder, and meat extract powder. The Medical Segment offers manufactures and sells semi-solid products, such as ointments, creams, and lotions; solid products, including tablets and powders for the generic drug market; vitamin c preparations, gargle, and generic skin external preparation. Its Industrial Chemicals Segment provides research and development of surface treatment chemicals; development of new manufacturing methods; products for PWBS, electronic devices, general platings, and semiconductors. The Social Impact Business Segment is involved in cooperative relationships with the local community, discovering local resources, and creating new businesses that lead to the resolution of social issues. The company was formerly known as Iwaki & Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Astena Holdings Co., Ltd. in June 2021. Astena Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1914 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

ファインケミカル事業は、CMC事業*1、CDMO事業*2、調達プラットフォーム事業の3事業を柱とし、医薬品開発・製造分野において幅広く展開しています。 CMC事業は、開発ステージに適した医療用医薬品の研究開発、治験原薬・治験薬製造などのサービスをハイレベルで提供しています。 CDMO事業は、固形製剤、注射製剤の治験薬製造から商用製造が可能な設備を有しております。注射設備においては、日米欧の3極PIC/S GMPに準拠するカテゴリー5相当の封じ込めに対応しております。 調達プラットフォーム事業では、多彩かつ高度な大量製造技術を活かし、ジェネリック医薬品の商用原薬の製造、新薬の中間体および原薬の受託製造を手がけ、国内外の信頼あるメーカーから、各種原料・中間体、添加物等の調達と販売をおこなっています。 また、独自の合成技術を活かし、環境に優しく高品質・低コストで、ペプチド原薬の製造プロセスの開発・技術移管・ライセンス事業をおこなうほか、創薬インキュベーション事業として、ベンチャー等への出資を通して、国内の新薬開発に貢献しています。 *1 CMC : Chemistry, Manufacturing and Control, *2 CDMO : Contract Development & business_summary: Inabata & Co.,Ltd. engages in information and electronics, chemicals, life industry, and plastics businesses in Japan and internationally. The company offers polarizing films, materials for polarizing films, alignment layer materials, color resist, material for backlights and OLEDs, surface treatment equipment and films, driver ICs, led encapsulants, materials for non-woven mask and special-use tape for display, automotive-related films, sensors, and various materials for power semiconductors. It also provides materials and equipment for the display and semiconductor domains, including semiconductor manufacturing equipment and mask blanks; develop and manufacture plastic for LED encapsulants in-house, as well as plastics for display encapsulants, heat dissipation plastics, and high-refractive-index resins; and supplies materials and equipment for displays and semiconductors, materials for advanced semiconductor substrates, and power semiconductor wafers. In addition, the company offers synthetic resin and fiber materials, catalysts, antioxidants, ultraviolet absorbents, solvents, polymerization initiators, functional resins, silicone, silane products, health care-related products, materials for data recording papers and polyurethane form, products for pipelines, and inorganic materials for public infrastructure and civil engineering related products; coating materials; sell materials for automobile parts and chemicals, as well as materials and products for housing, housing material, and housing equipment manufacturers; import and sell wooden materials; and businesses for wood and housing materials. Further, it sells plastics, molded plastic products, and machinery; supplies plastic materials; solutions for plastic materials, logistics, and financing for manufacturing equipment; and offers molded products. The company was founded in 1890 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

business_summary: GSI Creos Corporation offers textiles and industrial products in Japan and internationally. It offers fibers for use in materials for innerwear, legwear, stockings, tights, and socks, sweaters, and bedding; recycled and biodegradable materials; natural fibers; elastic, finished, and functional yarns; plant-derived, thermal, semi-synthetic, and cooling fiber; and women, men, and children clothing, outdoor wear, and sportswear. It also engages in production, and sale of modeling paints, tools, plastic models, and products for handcrafts; selling household items and sanitary goods; insoles; e- commerce business; supply of spatial care, antibacterial, and antiviral masks, and bathtime tops; selling health food ingredients; and selling medical devices, including dialysis machines and equipment. In addition, it engages in the handling of cosmetic raw materials derived from plants, the ocean, microalgaeas; skin and haircare raw materials; and provides nail oils as nail-related products, including nail art brushes, nail oils, files, cleaners, air nail system, reed diffuser, base gel, and nail balm. Further, it develops and sells products with cutting-edge technologies; machineries used for the manufacturing of industrial products, semiconductors, and medical devices; supplies silicon wafers, ceramic materials, and quartz parts; vaporizers, wafter transfer robots, and deformation measuring devices and particle coating; and engages in import, export, and sales of various industrial components. Additionally, it offers cleaning and glass parting agents; rubber hoses; papers; self-healing paints; fluorine and fluorine materials; electrical discharge, plastic molding, composite material-related, and textile machines; ion exchange resins; filters; materials; and equipment. The company was formerly known as Gunze Sangyo, Inc. and changed its name to GSI Creos Corporation in 2001. GSI Creos Corporation was incorporated in 1931 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: Meiwa Corporation engages in the chemicals, lubricants, battery materials, automotive and mineral resources, and environmental businesses in Japan, China, and internationally. The company offers mineral resources comprising rare earth elements, rare metals, environmental products, metal products, activated carbon, quartz, inorganic raw materials, pharmaceutical intermediates, and others; and antinomy trioxide plus brominated and phosphorus flame retardants. It also provides construction materials, including waterproof materials, heat-insulating materials/subsidiary materials, interior trim materials, internal store trim materials, flooring materials, wooden packaging materials, and residential fittings; and petroleum products, such as fuel, heavy fuel oil, lubricating oil and grease, base oil, refrigerant oils, lubricant additives, solvent oils, asphalt, process oils, slack waxes, liquid paraffins, and other products. In addition, the company sells various films and processed films, including resins, high-precision chemicals, fillers, and printing materials; general-purpose resins, engineering plastics, super engineering plastics, PVC compounds, and elastomers, as well as foam products, FRP materials, and processed plastic products. Further, it provides lithium-ion battery cathode/anode materials, electrolyte, separator, raw materials and intermediate products, energy storage battery system, other battery products and materials, anthracite coal and processed anthracite products, and limestone and processed limestone products; and general automotive parts and materials, and raw materials. Meiwa Corporation was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

business_summary: KUWAZAWA Holdings Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides construction materials and works in Japan. The company sells basic materials, including cement, ready-mixed concretes, civil engineering materials, and steel products; interior and exterior materials; building materials; housing equipment, such as kitchens and modular baths; lumber and structural materials; and private brand products. It also provides construction services, such as interior finishing, exterior wall, waterproofing, tile, and glass sash works, as well as steel bridge, scaffolding, and water supply and drainage equipment construction; and designs and constructs custom-built and condominium homes, renovation and repair works, and sale of real estate. In addition, the company offers transportation services comprising construction materials delivery, automobile and crane leasing and rental, civil engineering work, warehousing, and logistics; produces and sells ready-mixed and secondary concrete products; and processes and sells sashes, sash assembly work, and sheet glass and door installation. Further, it is involved in personal and corporate insurance agency businesses; automobile maintenance and repair; various support services; facility management; and collection, transportation, and disposal of waste. The company was formerly known as KUWAZAWA Trading Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to KUWAZAWA Holdings Corporation in October 2020. KUWAZAWA Holdings Corporation was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

business_summary: Bitcoin Japan Corporation engages in the manufacture and wholesale of women's clothing products in Japan. It operates through Kimono, Lifestyle, Fashion, and Materials segments. The company plans, produces, and sells twisted yarns; offers women's clothing and home wear products; and wholesales kimono accessories and jewelry to department, specialty, and retail stores; produces gift catalogs for gift items, funeral items, etc. It also provides health products, which include bedding products. The company was formerly known as Marushohotta Co.,Ltd. and change its name to Bitcoin Japan Corporation in November 2025. Bitcoin Japan Corporation was founded in 1861 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Bitcoin Japan Corporation is a subsidiary of RIZAP Group Co., Ltd.

business_summary: Unicharm Corporation engages in the manufacturing and sale of pet care and related products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Personal Care, Pet Care, and Others segments. It offers wellness care, feminine care, baby and child care products, as well as food-packaging materials, etc. The company also provides napkin-type incontinence pads, pants-type diapers, tape-type diapers, pants-type specialized urine pads, and tape-type specialized urine pads under the Lifree brand name; specialized liners for incontinence care under the Charm Nap brand name; fabric and facial masks under the Chorittai and Chokaiteki Mask brand name; Home care products under Wave brand; and kitchen paper towel under the Cook Up brand name. In addition, it offers pet food under the Pet Dog Genki, Pet Cat Genki, Grand Deli, Best Balance, Silver Spoon, Silver Plate, AllWell, and Physicalife brand names, as well as excrement cleanup sheets, disposable diapers, apparel-like absorption wear for excretion-care for dogs, and Deo-Sand series and Deo-Toilet system products for cats. Further, the company provides feminine care products including feminine napkins, tampons, sanitary shorts, and panty liners under the Sofy and Silcot names; and disposable baby diaper under the Moony, Mamy Poko, Trepanman, and Oyasuminman brands. Additionally, it is involved in recycling of disposable diapers, as well as offering products under RefF brand. Unicharm Corporation was incorporated in 1941 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
